# Historic sample corpus

**Synthetic** (#304). Generated by `tools/samples/make_synthetic_basic_sample.py`;
do not hand-edit, regenerate:

    python3 tools/samples/make_synthetic_basic_sample.py \
        --out capture/src/test/resources/sample-corpus

Twelve BASIC files in the corpus's own layout
(`<year>/<Mon>/<day>/<event id>/<market id>.bz2`), read by the historic load
and projection tests. Until #304 these were twelve verbatim files from the
real corpus. Betfair's data may not be committed, and the originals are still
in custody under the same relative paths. The market ids here are
`1.9xxxxxxxx` and the event ids `999xxxxx`, so none can be mistaken for a real
market.

Invented values are enough because every test that reads these compares two
readings of the same bytes: stored against extracted, or projected against
parsed. The shape is not invented. `SyntheticBasicShapeTest` fails the build
if a file uses any key path, JSON type, key set or enumerated value missing
from `../basic-shape.json`, and `BasicShapeManifestIT` (the `-Preplay` tier)
reads that manifest off every real BASIC file.

| Month | Events | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| 2020-03 | two, never played: suspended, then CLOSED with every runner REMOVED | the month `HistoricProjectionIntegrationTest` projects, whose "absence is NULL" test needs no market to settle a WINNER |
| 2024-03 | two, played: pre-play, in play, goal suspensions, WINNER/LOSER settlement | more than one market, so `HistoricProjectionAtomicityTest` has work in front of the market it refuses |
